page_title: RBL 2-0 DAR | RB Leipzig v Darmstadt 09/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
90+2' RB Leipzig have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' A dangerous looking corner kick from Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is cleared to safety by the defence.
89' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
87' Marco Rose has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) replacing Mohamed Simakan.
86' Darmstadt failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
84' Substitution. Bartol Franjic did his best and is replaced by Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt).
83' Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
81' RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
79' RB Leipzig have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
77' Substitution. Yussuf Poulsen makes way for Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig).
77' Here is a change. Kevin Kampl is going off and Marco Rose gives the last tactical orders to Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig).
76' An accurate cross into the centre of the box from Mohamed Simakan gives Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) a clear sight of goal, but he sends his headed effort narrowly wide of the left post.
75' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) whips in a cross from the corner, but Peter Gulacsi is well positioned and punches the ball away.
74' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Yussuf Poulsen.
71' David Raum (RB Leipzig) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) for Lois Openda.
67' The substitution has been made. Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) has replaced Oscar Vilhelmsson.
67' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to make a change. Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) replaces Gerrit Holtmann.
67' Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
66' Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) zig-zags his way into the box and fails to direct a shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop.
64' Thomas Poppler Isherwood (Darmstadt) and Emir Karic matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
63' Darmstadt can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
62' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

60' What a wasted opportunity by Lois Openda (RB Leipzig)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Marcel Schuhen makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
58' RB Leipzig hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
56' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) covers his face with his hands after spurning a great chance. The ball rebounded to him but his close-range header went a whisker over the crossbar.
53' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
52' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
50' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom left corner. Xaver Schlager provided an assist for the goal.

48' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Marcel Schuhen to get hold of the ball.
48' Golden opportunity! Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
47' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes the corner which is cleared.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Torsten Lieberknecht probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Fabio Torsiello (Darmstadt). He is replaced by Sebastian Polter.
46' Torsten Lieberknecht makes a half-time substitution. Emir Karic comes on in place of Andreas Muller (Darmstadt).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Eljif Elmas (RB Leipzig) is replaced by Christoph Baumgartner.
46' The whistle blows and Robert Hartmann starts the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Eljif Elmas (RB Leipzig) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball.
44' Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
42' The shots on goal statistics – 3:1.
40' Eljif Elmas (RB Leipzig) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Marcel Schuhen pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
39' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just over the bar.
39' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes the corner.
36' A clumsy foul by Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) and Robert Hartmann blows his whistle.
33' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
32' RB Leipzig win a direct free kick in a dangerous mid-range position.
30' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
30' David Raum (RB Leipzig) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. RB Leipzig force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
27' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
25' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away.
24' Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort.
23' Corner kick. Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) is ready to send the ball into the box.
23' Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Peter Gulacsi has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
22' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
19' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) trips an opposition player and Robert Hartmann signals a foul.
16' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) plays an extraordinary diagonal pass and Mohamed Simakan darts into free space to control the ball.
14' Fabio Torsiello (Darmstadt) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
14' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Xavi Simons.
11' RB Leipzig are seeing far more of the ball now.
8' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) fails to convert the free kick from the edge of the box. His shot goes right into the stands. High, wide and not at all handsome.
7' RB Leipzig get the opportunity to endanger the opposition's goal with a free kick from the edge of the box.
7' Andreas Muller (Darmstadt) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
6' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Kevin Kampl.
3' 1 - 0 Thomas Poppler Isherwood (Darmstadt) was unlucky to score an own goal attempting to intercept a cross. Hang your head in shame!
3' David Raum (RB Leipzig) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. RB Leipzig will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Robert Hartmann.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
